items.t: CVT shudder or surging
items.job: Replace CVT valve body (control valve) per service bulletin
items.note: If the belt and pulleys are damaged, a full CVT replacement costs several thousand dollars. Check powertrain warranty coverage first.

items.t: Check engine light and power loss from ignition coils
items.job: Replace all ignition coils with countermeasure parts
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $261-$301 for coil replacement. Covered under the 5-year/60,000-mile warranty when new.

items.t: Check engine light with cam timing codes
items.job: Reprogram engine computer; replace oil control valve if needed

items.t: Stalling or weak throttle in cold weather
items.job: Reprogram engine computer software

items.t: Check engine light with speed limited
items.job: Reprogram engine computer software

items.t: Fuel smell from the A/C vents
items.job: Inspect for fuel vapor leak and replace breather and vacuum hoses

items.t: Coolant warning light from leaking hose
items.job: Replace water hose and countermeasure hose clamp

items.t: Rattle from exhaust manifold heat shield
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold heat protector

items.t: Weak heat at idle or low speed
items.job: Reprogram A/C control unit software

items.t: Noise from the heater blower
items.job: Diagnose and repair HVAC blower noise

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Reprogram instrument cluster

items.t: Driver window or lock switch sticks or stops working
items.job: Replace driver power window switch

items.t: Front window rattle or chatter
items.job: Replace front door glass run channel

items.t: Glove box won't latch
items.job: Repair or replace glove box latch

items.t: Driver seat slowly sinks
items.job: Replace manual seat height adjustment levers

items.t: Pulls to one side or steering wheel off-center
items.job: Four-wheel alignment

items.t: Liftgate won't stay open
items.job: Replace liftgate gas springs (pair)

items.t: Vibration from out-of-balance wheels on new vehicles
items.job: Balance all four wheels

items.t: Smartphone link, CarPlay or Android Auto glitches
items.job: Update Smartphone Link Display Audio software

items.t: Blind spot warning acts up
items.job: Reprogram gateway computer software

items.t: Automatic headlights stay on in daylight
items.job: Reprogram ETACS body computer

items.t: Collision mitigation brakes longer than needed (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer

items.t: Emergency braking, ABS or stability control may not work (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Mitsubishi dealer
